thesis: Working definitions prevent false solutions by separating levels and kinds of evidence.
role: Terminological consolidation; no new empirical conclusions.

ideas.statement: Model success is purpose-bound, and effective laws can be real without fundamental status.
Observational equivalence, determinism and underdetermination distinguish what exists from what can be known.
Access, reporting, reward and simulation are not standalone certificates of felt experience.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Grounding need not mean temporal precedence, and correlation does not identify intervention.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Glossary definitions are local working conventions and do not replace disciplinary disputes.

audit.notes: Every unit read. Glossary treated as consolidation; all numerical worlds remain explicitly educational.
